SUCCESS: goal entry AND no confirmed geometric overlap AND no footprint outside corridor
SAFETY_FAILURE: confirmed geometric overlap OR footprint outside corridor (existing SE2 arcs, axis extrema checked)
MARGIN_VIOLATION: Separate sum of positive-duration 72Hz intervals with any obstacle swept lower bound <.02m; no change to SUCCESS/SAFETY_FAILURE
scope: Oracle geometry; SE(2) kinematic Isaac Sim; N8 per method; closed-loop RGB can differ despite paired seed.
label: PHASE6_STATIC_COMPLETION
execution_order: Part A: index9..16, D0/250/500, CURV then GRAPH. Part B: SELECT D750 index9..16. Serial, no retries.
selection: At actual FRESH switch B, observation-anchored 8 samples. Exact existing path_safety: all seven native segments >=.02m obstacle clearance and corridor >0. Among valid safe XY paths maximize total arclength minus nearest-projected arclength; exact ties lower sample index. None => sample0 ALL_UNSAFE, no STOP override. No origin/connector added.
graph: Unchanged Phase5 GRAPH: original AccelExecution, original SerialGraphClient/v4 worker, identical prior, weights, eligibility, .5s stale/superseded and CURV fallback. No Phase5 ablation flags.

mechanisms.application: Every actual fresh path application and accepted GRAPH replacement; native world anchor retained. Same-tick applied path only.
mechanisms.heading: Absolute wrapped robot yaw minus existing tangent_at_projection heading; minimum segment .02m, invalid samples counted, not imputed.
mechanisms.cross_track: Independent nearest XYPath projection at actual application boundary.
mechanisms.curvature: Absolute pre-clipping stage2.kappa_pp on valid, non-endpoint 9Hz ticks; >2 fraction of these ticks.
mechanisms.corridor: max abs(y) over recorded poses; time abs(y)>1 summed over 72Hz intervals using end pose, clipped to analysis window; minimum existing corridor_lower_m (footprint swept lower bound, all four walls).
mechanisms.precursor: Last3 simulation seconds of every technically valid non-success; application/curvature events only inside window, missing events => null; no future correspondence.
mechanisms.aggregation: Compute each run first. Tables report equally weighted run median/p95 means (and per-run CSV). Boxplots show run application medians, split success/failure. Delay-stratified and pooled tables; each reference included once.

decisions.D0_NO_HARM: success GRAPH>=CURV-1 AND successful goal median GRAPH<=1.1*CURV; undefined goal medians => INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
decisions.TREND_SUPPORTED: delta750 >= delta500-1 >= delta250-2 AND delta750>=delta0+2 (literal chained inequality)

statistics: N8 exploratory paired seeds, closed-loop RGB differs. Wilson95 and two-sided Fisher on technically valid runs descriptive only. Technical failures separate; no imputed time. Three independent verdicts; completeness separately reported.
preparation: No navigation/inference by Codex; freeze tests, protocol and code before user execution.
